# Avoid namespace imports in the shared mbox header

The historical locking patch added using namespace mozilla in MboxMsgInputStream.h. Its later correction removed that import, qualified the member mozilla::Mutex, and imported only mozilla::MutexAutoLock in the implementation file. Recommend this scoped header pattern for related changes so includers do not inherit an unintended namespace import. The linked coding-style page was not read while external access was blocked. This is static source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/base/src.
